items.title: Right of withdrawal (Widerruf) from the furniture purchase
items.quote: Sie können Ihre Bestellung binnen vierzehn Tagen widerrufen, ohne Gründe zu nennen. Die Frist läuft ab dem Tag, an dem Sie die Ware erhalten haben.
items.computation: The withdrawal period is 14 days, running from the day the goods were received (§ 355 Abs. 2, § 356 Abs. 2 BGB). Goods were delivered 2026-11-18 (Wednesday), per the letter's own statement. The day of receipt is not counted (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), so counting starts 2026-11-19; 14 days later lands on 2026-12-02 (Wednesday). That day is a normal business day in Bavaria (no weekend/holiday shift needed under § 193 BGB). Sending the withdrawal notice by that date is sufficient (rechtzeitig, wenn vor Fristende abgesendet); it need not arrive by then.

warnings: This is a consumer right-of-withdrawal notice (Widerrufsbelehrung), not a Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung from an authority; no einspruch/widerspruch/klage applies here.

The invoice total of 3.034,00 € is stated as already paid ('bereits bezahlt'), so no payment is currently due; if withdrawn, the company states it will refund this amount and collect the furniture at its own cost.
